summary: State-dependent dispatch. If ByteFieldGetterAt100 returns nonzero, calls vtable entry 16 (offset 0x40) with argument 5; otherwise, if ShortComputation_6720 returns 5, calls vtable entry 16 with argument 0. vtable entry 43 (offset 0xAC) is always called afterward on both paths. Returns 0 in both paths.

local_names.this: dispatch object whose vtable carries entries at offsets 0x40 and 0xAC
local_names.v2: decompiler register variable passed uninitialized to ShortComputation_6720

operations.description: If ByteFieldGetterAt100(this) returns nonzero, take the true dispatch path
Virtual dispatch through vtable entry 16 (offset 0x40 on obj) with argument 5 (stdcall, no this)
Virtual dispatch through vtable entry 43 (offset 0xAC on obj) with this
On the false path, if ShortComputation_6720(v2) equals 5, take the secondary dispatch
Virtual dispatch through vtable entry 16 (offset 0x40 on obj) with this and argument 0
Virtual dispatch through vtable entry 43 (offset 0xAC on obj) with this

unresolved: ShortComputation_6720 receives the decompiler register variable v2 that is never assigned in this function; its effective input is unknown
